commit.message:
fix(logs): pin the first-chunk-timestamp collector for CRI records (w4/m199)

A record the runtime wrote as CRI partial chunks reached history with its
last chunk's time while the pod-log live tail used the first chunk's, so the
dashboard rendered one 50 KB record twice. Pin the log-shipper to the
published ghcr.io/bex-co/bex-alloy digest (Alloy v1.11.2 + carried patch).

The harness now replays all four CRI pipelines (app, build, Postgres with
CNPG unwrapping, Key Value) in the pinned image: P→F, repeated P across a
second boundary, interleaved stderr, single-F control and the unchanged
200000-byte cap. These fail on stock v1.11.2 and pass on the pin;
BEX_ALLOY_IMAGE replays a candidate before pinning. ADR010/ADR018 record
the rule and the Render comparison's limits.
